answer: Sybil defense succeeds when each identity costs real capital that is forfeited on misbehavior. Before an agent can collect attestation work it locks a bond sized to what it could extract, so a thousand fake agents need a thousand bonds. Failed claims slash the bond to honest verifiers, so every clone is a paid loss. Joins also emit a signed pulse checked against a shared randomness signal, exposing wallets funded together or created in one block, which traps cheap clones in an expensive spiral.
